newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Unicom said raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Unicom said raised.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer & Co raised its rating on Unicom Corp to outperform from market perform, a source at the brokerage said.
-- The analyst was not immediately available for comment.
-- Analyst John Raleigh said in a research note that Unicom was trading at a 30 percent discount to the group and that its current price made it a good stock for value oriented investors.
He said the discount "reflected investor concern over nuclear problems, competative issues, regulatory uncertainty ... and a significant drop off in 1996 EPS.

"(W)e are raising our rating on the stock to outperform from market perform, recognizing that widespread disdain for UCM shares probably offers investors an opportunity to buy a lower quality utility stock at a discount to its peers."
